feeds.title: Dirt Simple Blog
feeds.description: The Dirt Simple blog features landscape design and garden observations by Deborah Silver, a landscape and garden designer and owner of the Detroit Garden Works retail store. We have been writing this blog since April of 2009 that addresses both horticultural and design issues in the the landscape.

feeds.title: Successful Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find articles on how to design and plant your garden to make the most of your available space & budget. Rachel Mathews is a garden designer from the UK, with over 25 years of professional design experience. In that time, she has designed hundreds of gardens all over the world.

feeds.title: Paper Garden Workshop Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lisa Orgler and I love teaching garden design in a fun and simple way. Paper Garden Workshop means a spirited place to learn garden design.

feeds.title: Cape Contours Blog
feeds.description: Explore our gardening blog for landscaping tips, news, and reviews. Also Cape Contour's garden design specials and inspiration from around the world. Cape Contours provide a variety of quality landscaping services: Landscape creation, implementation & maintenance for residential and commercial properties.

feeds.title: Royale Stones Blog
feeds.description: Royale Stones came into existence in 2012 and since then we have supplied paving products to thousands of happy homes all over the United Kingdom. We stock a wide variety of paving products, ethically sourced from all around the world to suit multiple tastes. The blog features various articles and posts related to the company's products, as well as general tips and advice on garden design and landscaping.

feeds.title: Graduate Landscapes Blog
feeds.description: Graduate Landscapes is Surrey and Hampshire award winning garden design company with over 20 years of experience in garden designing, garden construction and garden maintenance of beautiful gardens, Graduate Landscapes offers a creative, personal and unique garden design service.

feeds.title: JJ Garden Designs Blog
feeds.description: For more than 20 years, JJ Garden Designs has been creating exceptional gardens within Suffolk and beyond. Fully qualified designers and horticulturalists.

feeds.title: Jack Wallington Garden Design
feeds.description: I'm Jack Wallington. I'm a RHS qualified Garden Designer based in Clapham, London. Training with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, I aim to transform people's gardens, homes and lives with outstanding garden designs. My style is contemporary and naturalistic, and I can work with any conditions, whether it's low maintenance, dry shade, full sun or even something more adventurous.

feeds.title: Plews Garden Design
feeds.description: Plews offers Garden Design, Garden Consultancy and Gardening Advice; plus unique Gardening Lessons, where your garden is the classroom. Plews is based in Bromley, covering mainly London, Kent Surrey and Sussex. Gardening blogs and eBooks are written by Marie Shallcross the owner of Plews Garden Design and available from the website.

feeds.title: GardenDesignOnline
feeds.description: Jane Berger is a journalist and landscape designer based in Washington DC. Jane's landscape design business is Garden Design Online, serving the Washington DC Metro Area and other areas via e-designs.

feeds.title: Todd Haiman Landscape Design Blog
feeds.description: Todd Haiman Landscape Design Inc. in New York City designs and builds residential gardens, roof gardens, terraces, brownstone gardens, large landscapes, vacation properties and public spaces. Get information and advice on garden design and landscape design by following this blog.

feeds.title: Oxford College of Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Oxford College of Garden Design offers Landscape and garden design courses.

feeds.title: Bowles & Wyer Blog
feeds.description: Bowles & Wyer have become leading landscape and garden designers and contractors, working throughout London, Central England and the South East. Chris Bowles and award-winning designer John Wyer have worked together since the early 80's, officially launching Bowles & Wyer in 1993.

feeds.title: Growing Rooms Landscapes For Outdoor Living
feeds.description: Growing Rooms is a Sydney based landscape design company specializing in urban garden design, construction & maintenance creating outdoor spaces in harmony with your home. Follow Growing Rooms blog for latest landscape industry news and garden design ideas.

feeds.title: The Garden Company Blog
feeds.description: The Garden Company was founded by James Scott in 1991 with a business partner and specialises in high quality commercial and domestic garden landscaping, design and maintenance.

feeds.title: Welsh Slate Water Features Blog
feeds.description: Garden Design & Lifestyle Blog by Welsh Slate Water Features. Inspiration & ideas for creating beautiful gardens.

feeds.title: Lisa Cox Garden Designs
feeds.description: I'm Lisa Cox. I'm an RHS award-winning designer at both Cardiff and Chelsea flower shows and I'm also a registered member of the Society of Garden Designers, having passed the only professional adjudication process for garden designers in the UK. I work with professional landscapers and specialist craftspeople to help bring my designs to life.

feeds.title: Oakleigh Manor Blog
feeds.description: Oakleigh Manor was founded in 1996 and since then we have evolved into a multi-disciplined team of talented professionals. We incorporate a Landscape & Garden Design Team, highly skilled Landscape & Garden Construction Craftsmen, Garden Joinery, Irrigation, Lighting & Automation Engineers and a caring team of Garden & Grounds Maintenance staff who provide ongoing aftercare and maintenance.

feeds.title: Janna Schreier Garden Design
feeds.description: In 2007, I resigned from my corporate job at Heathrow to follow my husband's career abroad. I engaged in a distance learning course with the Royal Horticultural Society and have never looked back. My passion for gardens knows no bounds and I hope I can inspire you to develop your love of gardening too.

feeds.title: PITH VIGOR
feeds.description: Pit And Vigor is a digital magazine and print newspaper for people with dirt under thier nails published by Rochelle Greayer. The blog is all about Garden Design Ideas, inspiration by style, region, trend. Products, plants, gardeners & garden designers.

feeds.title: Kate Gould Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Kate Gould is an award winning garden designer for London and the Home Counties. With over seventeen years hands on experience Kate is regularly commissioned by home-owners, architects and interior designers as well as property developers and commercial clients to transform gardens of all sizes.

feeds.title: Alyse Lansing Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Alyse Lansing is a landscape designer. Follow this blog to know anything regarding all things that inspire the making and keeping of a garden.

feeds.title: David Keegans Garden Design
feeds.description: A blog by the award winning garden and landscape designer David Keegan. Award winner 'Residential Landscape Designer of The Year 2016' Northern Design Awards . Award winner 'International Landscape Design 2012', 'APLD' USA. Award winner 'Garden Designer of the Year 2010, 2011, and 2013 Northern Design Awards. Currently working on garden design projects in Cheshire, Manchester, Derbyshire.

feeds.title: Sculpt Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning and qualified landscape designers & gardeners, living on Auckland's North Shore who design, install, and care for the beautiful gardens they create. We give advice and help to create the garden of your dreams

feeds.title: Jane Harries Garden Designs Blog
feeds.description: Jane Harries qualified in garden design with the Open College of the Arts (OCA), the sister organization to the Open University. She has been gardening for 15 years in her Northamptonshire cottage garden and enjoys growing perennials from seed.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Garden Designer Blog
feeds.description: Sally has been designing gardens for 18 years and is a Registered Member of the Society of Garden Designers, which is the only body for professional garden designers. She trained at Askham Bryan College, York and left there with a BSc (Hons) in Landscape Management and a HND in Horticulture.

feeds.title: Elementa Garden Design
feeds.description: Elementa is a specialist landscape design consultancy run by Nick Dickinson, providing landscape design and installation services. Elementa Design specialise in designing and installing gardens in Gloucestershire and beyond.

feeds.title: Nancy Rodgers Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Surrey Garden Designer. Working in Guildford, Dorking, Reigate, Horsham and surrounding areas with trusted landscapers, Nancy oversees each project from start to finish. From country gardens to urban courtyards, Nancy Rodgers designs gardens in tune with her clients' vision and practical requirements.

feeds.title: Selma Klophaus Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Selma Klophaus is a Garden Designer and Landscape Architect in Cornwall. Design and creation of planters, to full-scale landscaping; private gardens and large estates alike, stunning outdoor spaces that capture the soul.

feeds.title: Jon Gower Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Jon Gower is a qualified garden designer based on the Essex/Suffolk border. Stay up to date with Jon's Garden Design work with his regular blog articles.

feeds.title: Dewlands Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Dewlands Garden Design is a bespoke garden design service with the experience to develop, project manage, and build your garden ideas.

feeds.title: Michael Cooke Garden Design Blog
feeds.description: Michael Cooke Garden Design is a specialist team producing a limited number of exclusive landscape design projects each year.

feeds.title: Urban Gardens
feeds.description: The freshest innovative and eco-friendly designs, trends and ideas for stylish urban gardens and small spaces. Urban Gardens is an award-winning and Webby-nominated lifestyle blog with a creative blend of urban style, design, and nature curated from around the globe.

feeds.title: Pretty Purple Door Blog
feeds.description: Express your creativity in the garden. Amy helps beginner gardeners & design beautiful landscapes that are colorful in all four seasons. If you want to turn your garden into your canvas, then this blog is for you.

feeds.title: Michael McCoy Blog
feeds.description: I'm Michael McCoy. I'm a garden designer, writer, and occasional garden tour leader. I started my adult life as a botanist, then trained as a gardener. Wrestling with questions of gardens and gardening.

feeds.title: Summer House 24 Blog
feeds.description: Summerhouse24 offers premium quality wooden garden summer houses, garden log cabins, garden offices, BBQ huts, garages, and sheds in the UK at reasonable prices.

feeds.title: Scot Eckley Landscaping Blog
feeds.description: With this blog Scot Eckley hopes to catalogue his field notes of photos, project designs, events and designers that inspire great garden design and outdoor living. It is also a way to share the exciting events and milestones happening at Scot Eckley Inc.

feeds.title: Vialii Garden Design
feeds.description: Vialii Garden Design is committed to delivering excellent quality landscaping and garden designs to both residential and commercial gardens throughout central Scotland. Here we'll try to keep you abreast of all things Vialii along with our perspective on the latest trends in garden design.
